response.name:
PromoteReleaseResponse contains the release properties.

AirgapBuilds field semantics:
Body.AirgapBuilds (top-level) — one entry per channel JUST promoted to by
THIS call. Populated for every promoted channel, not just auto-build ones,
because the airgap-builder runs metadata generation for every promoted
channel-release and that step can fail. Each entry's FullAirgapBuild bool
distinguishes channels that produce a full bundle (auto-build on) from
those that only get metadata generation (auto-build off). CLI / GitHub
Action waiters should poll these.
Body.Release.AirgapBuilds (nested) — the FULL history of channel-releases
for this release sequence (including prior re-promotes to the same channel).
Use for inspect / history views, not for waiting on the current promote.
